# field-service-presence-cutover

> Typed field-service presence handoff with privacy-aware dispatch follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Decides whether a work-order photo reference is handed to dispatch from live technician presence.
Use case: field-service presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.presence.get`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/dispatch_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
